Markets.title: JP Morgan to add Philippines and Saudi Arabia to key EM bond index over 10 months
Markets.summary: JPMorgan will add Saudi Arabia and the Philippines to its emerging market debt index starting in 2027 over a ten-month period. During this integration, Saudi Arabia's weight in the index will reach 2.71% and the maximum country weight limit will adjust from 10% to 9%.

Markets.title: The average US 30-year mortgage rate falls to 7.18% this week, its third straight decline
Markets.summary: The average U.S. 30-year fixed mortgage rate fell to 7.18% this week, marking its third consecutive weekly decline. This decrease, along with a drop in 15-year mortgage rates to 6.57%, helps reduce financial pressure on prospective homebuyers.

Markets.title: US yields fall in choppy session as oil rises and equities sink
Markets.summary: US Treasury yields fell and equity markets declined as investors reacted to geopolitical tensions surrounding US-Iran relations. Meanwhile, a resilient labor market with dropping unemployment claims and heightened productivity continued to signal ongoing inflation risks.

Markets.title: Paras Healthcare posts Rs 40 crore Q2 net profit in first results after listing
Markets.summary: Paras Healthcare reported a net profit of Rs 40.35 crore for the September quarter, up from Rs 12.38 crore the previous year. Revenue from operations reached Rs 510.89 crore in the company's first financial results since its initial public offering.

Markets.title: Godfrey Phillips Q2 profit down 37% to Rs 190 cr; revenue up twofold at Rs 4,198 cr
Markets.summary: Godfrey Phillips India reported a 37.73 percent drop in net profit to Rs 190 crore for the September quarter due to a substantial tax increase. Despite this profit decline, the company's revenue surged twofold to Rs 4,198 crore.

Markets.title: Apple seeks about $7 billion from bond sale, Bloomberg News reports
Markets.summary: Apple is seeking to raise about $7 billion through a U.S.-dollar bond offering, according to Bloomberg News. The iPhone maker is using the debt market to fund its expanding artificial intelligence initiatives.

Geo-Political.title: Hoax bomb threats target European airlines and airports for second time in a week
Geo-Political.summary: For the second time in a week, hoax bomb threats targeted airports and airlines across Europe. At least 21 flights were affected by what the UK government described as a malicious hoax.

Geo-Political.title: Who could be behind hoax bomb threats to European air travel?
Geo-Political.summary: Recent hoax bomb threats targeting European air travel have no known perpetrators. Currently, there is no hard evidence linking these incidents to Russia, Iran, or any proxy groups.

Geo-Political.title: California governor commutes sentences for state's 548 death row inmates
Geo-Political.summary: California Governor Gavin Newsom has commuted the death sentences of all 548 inmates on the state's death row. This action shifts their punishments to life imprisonment without the possibility of parole.

Geo-Political.title: French protests see numbers surge as unions join strikes over high cost of living
Geo-Political.summary: French labor unions joined widespread strikes to protest the high cost of living. The interior ministry estimated that 600,000 people participated nationwide, though union figures were significantly higher.

Geo-Political.title: Paraguay President Santiago Peña resigns after bank collapse
Geo-Political.summary: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña resigned following a bank collapse. His resignation came after the lower house of congress voted to pursue an impeachment trial against him.

Geo-Political.title: Eight killed in series of shootings in western Turkey
Geo-Political.summary: Eight people were killed in a series of shootings across western Turkey. The victims were discovered in three separate vehicles at multiple locations.

Data & Insights.title: India gets Strait of Hormuz passage reprieve from Iran. What does Tehran expect in return?
Data & Insights.summary: Iran is allowing Indian ships to pass through the Strait of Hormuz to secure essential medicines, energy supplies, and diplomatic support. In exchange, Tehran expects continued trade and political cooperation from India amid rising regional tensions.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Primer | How will the blue tsunami in the US mid-terms benefit India?
Data & Insights.summary: The US mid-term elections are expected to result in a blue tsunami that could alter American foreign policy. Consequently, analysts anticipate that President Trump will pursue a negotiated settlement regarding the Iran war rather than continuing his aggressive approach.

Data & Insights.title: Snack makers tweak trade margins, engineer pouches to break  ₹5 pack habit
Data & Insights.summary: Rising costs of potatoes, edible oil, and packaging are squeezing profit margins on entry-level snack packs. To counter this, snack makers are pushing larger product sizes, redesigning packaging, and expanding premium offerings.

Data & Insights.title: Trump's midterm setback may give India an edge in trade deal
Data & Insights.summary: Despite the Republican defeat in the US midterm elections, the American embassy states that trade talks with India will continue. President Donald Trump remains firmly in control of Washington's trade agenda, which may give India an advantage in reaching an agreement.

Data & Insights.title: Explained: Why could a weak monsoon derail India's ambitious ethanol blending programme?
Data & Insights.summary: A weak monsoon and rising food prices are forcing India to prioritize food security over ethanol production. This shift could lower the fuel-blending rate below the 20% target and increase the country's reliance on imported crude.

India.title: After BJP Attack On Drugs, AAP Sends Bikram Majithia Drugs Case To Central Agency
India.summary: The Aam Aadmi Party has referred the Bikram Majithia drug case to a central agency amid the BJP's anti-drug campaign against the Punjab government. This move aims to shift political focus to the alleged Akali drug-money network and pressure the central government.

India.title: AAP Leader's Delhi-Punjab Air Quality Video Sparks Fresh Face-Off With BJP
India.summary: A video shared by AAP leader Jarnail Singh comparing Delhi and Punjab air quality sparked a political clash with the BJP. Singh defended the video, stating that a date-related issue on the display was merely a technical error that did not invalidate the pollution readings.

India.title: 6 Months Before Delhi Building Collapse, Owner Got A Warning. He Ignored It
India.summary: An initial investigation revealed that building owner Samiullah ignored an April advisory by illegally constructing new second and third floors without approval. Six months later, the Delhi building collapsed.

India.title: 4th Person Arrested For Kerala Teen's Murder. Victim Was Not Original Target
India.summary: Police arrested a fourth suspect in Kerala for the murder of 17-year-old Abhiram, who was lured via Instagram, beaten, and strangled. Investigators revealed that the teenager was not the killers' intended target.

India.title: 3 Fishermen Found Dead After Cyclone Murasu, Anger Erupts In Chennai's Kasimedu
India.summary: Three missing fishermen from Chennai were found dead in the Prakasam district of Andhra Pradesh following Cyclone Murasu. The discovery of their bodies sparked protests and anger among residents in Chennai's Kasimedu area.

India.title: 20 Years After Nano Row, Suvendu Adhikari Hopes For A Vehicle Factory In Singur
India.summary: Twenty years after the Tata Nano project collapsed due to protests that helped bring Mamata Banerjee to power, BJP leader Suvendu Adhikari is expressing hope for a new vehicle factory in Singur. The original 2006 industrial project by the Left government failed to produce any cars and instead triggered a massive political agitation.

General.title: Russell Brand found guilty of rape and sexual assault
General.summary: Russell Brand has been found guilty of rape and sexual assault. He faces a significant prison sentence and additional rape allegations.

General.title: Watch: Met Police release Brand interview footage
General.summary: Brand was convicted of one count of rape and three sexual assaults at Southwark Crown Court. The Metropolitan Police have released footage of his police interview following the verdict

General.title: Major tech stocks plunge as US midterms add to fears of AI slowdown
Henry Nowak’s killer has minimum term increased to 25 years by Court of Appeal
General.summary: The Court of Appeal increased Vickrum Digwa's minimum prison term for killing Henry Nowak to 25 years after ruling the original sentence was unduly lenient. The court also rejected Digwa's separate appeal to have his sentence reduced.

General.title: King relishes 'politically charged' deployments, Palace aide says
General.summary: A Palace aide stated that the King enjoys "politically charged" royal tours. This follows questions the monarch faced regarding the UK's involvement in the slave trade during his Caribbean trip.

General.title: California governor commutes sentences for state's 548 death row inmates
General.summary: California Governor Gavin Newsom has commuted the sentences of all 548 inmates on the state's death row to life without the possibility of parole. This action completely empties the largest death row population in the United States.
